Overview

Uzhhorod is a city in Zakarpattia with a population of 115,000. A charming city in western Ukraine near the Slovak border, known for its unique architecture and as a gateway to the Carpathians. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
